metadata.title: Mst. MAMOONA BIBI vs Syed MUHAMMAD UMAIR and others

full_text:
2020 Y L R 2086

[Lahore (Rawalpindi Bench)]

Before Mujahid Mustaqeem Ahmad, J

Mst. MAMOONA BIBI---Petitioner

Versus

Syed MUHAMMAD UMAIR and others---Respondents

Diary No. 1263 of 2020, decided on 7th February, 2020.

Family Courts Act (XXXV of 1964)---

----S. 25-A---Transfer of cases---Scope---Petitioner sought transfer of
suit from one Province to another---Validity---Section 25-A of Family Courts
Act, 1964, dealt with transfers of cases pending before Family
Court---Subsection (2b) of S. 25-A of Family Courts Act, 1964, was of relevance
for the purpose of determination of objection raised by the office---Petition
before the High Court was not competent in the wake of express provision of
law---Office objection was sustained.

Sardar Muhammad Irshad
for Petitioner.

ORDER

OBJECTION CASE

MUJAHID MUSTAQEEM AHMAD, J.---By way of captioned petition the petitioner
seeks transfer of suit titled "Syed Muhammad Umair v. Mamoona Bibi"
pending before learned Family Court, Taxila Distt. Rawalpindi (Punjab) to the
learned Family Court, Haripur Distt. Abbottabad (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa) where suit
filed by the petitioner titled "Mamoona Bibi v. Syed Muhammad Umair"
is pending.

2. Office
has raised objection to file the petition before "Proper Bench/
Court".

3. Learned
counsel for the petitioner could not satisfy as to how this Court has
jurisdiction to transfer a case pending before a subordinate Court within
territorial jurisdiction of this Court to a subordinate Court within
territorial jurisdiction of another High Court.

4. Section
25-A of the West Pakistan Family Courts Act, 1964 deals with transfers of cases
pending before different Family Courts. Subsection (2B) of Section 25-A of the
Act is of relevance for the purpose of determination of objection raised in
this petition. Said provision of law reads as under:

"(2B)
On the application of any of the parties and after notice to the parties and
after hearing such of them as desired to be heard, or of its own motion without
such notice, the Supreme Court may at any stage transfer any suit, appeal or
other proceedings under this Act pending before a Court in one Province to a
Court in another Province, competent to try or dispose of the same.

5. In
the wake of above expressed provision of law this petition is not competent before
this court. Office object is, therefore, sustained.

SA/M-36/L Objection
sustained.
